newsitem.title: GERMANY: Rioters clash with German police in Magdeburg.
newsitem.headline: Rioters clash with German police in Magdeburg.

text.p: Young German punk rockers protesting against the death of a member of their group clashed with police overnight in the east German city of Magdeburg, hurling stones as police tried to clear their barricades, authorities said on Monday.
Three youths were detained, taking to 10 the number held since protests began on Sunday.
The protests started as a peaceful demonstration after one of the left-wing group was found to have been badly beaten, kicked and stabbed by unknown attackers.
When news was released that the punk rocker, who was found in a part of the city known as a bastion of Magdeburg's far-right scene, had died, the march turned violent.
Police investigating the matter said the dead youth could have been killed by right-wing radicals, but could equally have been the victim of a robbery or of fighting between rival left-wing gangs.
